scope: Read-only audit of completed development F histories and selected checkpoints. No fits, inference, store payload reads, or held-out reads. Weights alone do not measure feature information retained in predictions.
method: 714 run manifests and histories; 126 raw_patience checkpoints for fundamentals, magnitudes, C6. Float64 SVD with rank threshold max(matrix.shape)*float32_eps*largest_singular_value. Stable rank=sum(singular_values^2)/largest_singular_value^2. Gradients are epoch means from the second SAM pass before global clipping. Value-only statistics use the first feature_count columns of each family matrix, excluding the appended validity and age columns. Largest-direction energy is largest_singular_value^2/sum(singular_values^2). Reported medians are across the 42 selected checkpoints per arm.
